title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent lower back pain.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting for evaluation of chronic lower back pain. He reports a dull, aching sensation in the lumbar region that has persisted for approximately four months. He notes that the pain is exacerbated by prolonged sitting and heavy lifting, but it does not radiate into the lower extremities. He denies any recent falls or acute trauma. He has tried over-the-counter ibuprofen with minimal relief. He reports no numbness or tingling.

Medication List
Ibuprofen 400mg as needed, Lisinopril 10mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Physical exam shows no spinal tenderness to palpation. Range of motion of the lumbar spine is restricted by discomfort but shows no neurological deficits. Strength and sensation in lower extremities are intact and symmetric.

Assessment
1. Chronic lower back pain.

Plan
1. Prescribed physical therapy twice weekly for lumbar strengthening and mobility.
2. Recommended alternating heat and ice therapy.
3. Follow up in four weeks to assess progress.

Problem List
1. chronic systolic heart failure (HFrEF)
2. Chronic lower back pain
explanations: Heart failure appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
